name: claude-mods
description: Claude Code mods: GitHub PR typeahead, a PR status bar and panel, and handoff file typeahead

plugins.name: pr-autocomplete
plugins.description: Typeahead for GitHub PRs when you type # in a git repo

plugins.name: pr-bar
plugins.description: The current branch's GitHub PR as a bar above the prompt or a panel, with one-press commit, review and CI actions

plugins.name: handoff-autocomplete
plugins.description: Typeahead for recent /handoff plan files when you type handoff
